-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

`compute` performs `Console`, which its annotation does not list.

1| compute : Int -> String
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

3|     print n
       ^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    Int -> String

but the body needs:

    Int ->{Console} Int

-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

The annotation for `compute` says it returns:

    String

but its body returns:

    Int

4|     n
       ^
